text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Mirako-senpai, let's do our best! Little 
by little, heading into our first autumn 
races...!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, Dantsu-chan. She doesn't seem to be 
in peak condition, but even so.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"A body weighed down by lingering fatigue. 
Spirits that refuse to lift. Even so—"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The two of them were trying desperately to 
break out of their slump.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Haaah...! First comes the preliminary prep 
race before the G1!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Huh? I can't seem to brace myself... on 
the curves... Lately, I've been...

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: ââ!? Uuuu...

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Huh... There's no strength... in my right 
leg...?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Maybe I'll run in the Tenno Sho (Autumn) 
come fall. The distance might be a little 
short for me, though~

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
“In my case, I feel like it's mostly down 
to luck anyway. Ehehe...”

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Well, to be honest, my body... has felt 
completely sluggish this whole time, 
but...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Wait... Huh?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: What is this... My leg... kinda hurts?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
I wonder if my body is telling me it 
doesn't want to try hard. No, no, that 
can't be it...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Both complained of discomfort in their 
right leg. The examination results were...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Inflammation in their leg tendons and 
ligaments. It became clear that neither of 
them would be able to run this autumn.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry, No Reason-senpai...! I let my 
guard down.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Lately, my legs just... won't hold their 
ground for some reason, and this time was 
no different...

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: Lady Dantsu...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
I think I might feel the same way... There 
are times when I just can't seem to focus 
on running...

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: Mirako...

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The most likely explanation is...
choice_data_list: Maybe it wasn't summer fatigue after all
Maybe it wasn't summer fatigue after all

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The fierce battle at the Takarazuka Kinen. 
Marking a turning point, the two of 
them... entered a long, downward spiral.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The root cause is likely... extreme 
physical and mental exhaustion.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
What a... terrible turn of events... Both 
of the ones I held in high esteem, at the 
same time...

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
United in purpose... That's what I 
thought, but to think I must run through 
the autumn all alone...

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry, I'm so, so sorry, No 
Reason-senpai!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
If only I had approached it with a more 
serious attitude...

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: With an earnest mindset, huh...

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: —Nay, that cannot be so.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: No Reason gently shakes her head.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
You were more earnest than anyone. 
Single-minded to a fault. And that is 
precisely why—

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Without even a moment to catch your 
breath, you must be thoroughly exhausted. 
Forgive me; it is a failing on my part.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: No Reason-senpai...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: No Reason-chan...

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Mirako, I've pushed thee too hard as well, 
haven't I? For it is not merely the body, 
but also the mind that possesses its own 
"form."

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Forcing effort that doesn't fit your mold 
will naturally wear you down. You must 
have reached your absolute limit.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
This too... was my mistake for rushing you 
to win. Forgive me, you two.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—The setting sun. During the Sengoku 
period, many warlords faded from the grand 
stage. The reason why was...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It wasn't just because they were 
"defeated." There are many who simply 
burned out and naturally stepped away.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
No Reason-senpai, I'm so terribly sorry... 
What... what should I do...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Dantsu Flame had sunk all the way to rock 
bottom, but...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: ...It can't be helped, Dants-chan.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Mirako-senpai...?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"Since things turned out like this... All 
we can really do now is just go at our own 
pace..."

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Probably just waiting, I guess.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Waiting?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"Yeah. I might not be able to run right 
now, but that doesn't mean I'll never run 
again."

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
So you're saying all we can do is wait 
until I can run again, even if it's just a 
little.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"I can't constantly push through on pure 
guts like No Reason-chan does, but..."

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
If it's at my own pace... maybe I can 
manage a bit more.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
There is a saying: 'If the cuckoo will not 
sing, I shall wait until it sings.'

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Unlike No Reason's relentless rush through 
life, there surely exists a more relaxed 
racing career as well.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And a few days later—

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Then Lady Dants, are you saying you intend 
to wander the nation for a while?

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Yes. While I'm unable to do any serious 
training, I thought I might take a look 
around.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Places I've wanted to visit, like Kumamoto 
or Tochigi. I wonder what kind of 
different scenery awaits there.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
I see. Well, taking a break is good as 
well. I pray you have a safe and pleasant 
journey.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Take care, Dantsu-chan. I think I'll stay 
inside Tracen Academy and aim for an 
easygoing comeback.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
When you come back... let's play together 
again.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Mirako-senpai... Ugh... thank you so much.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Well then, No Reason-senpai, and 
Trainer-san, take care!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: Indeed! Lady Dants, you as well!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The bus departed. And what left wasn't 
just the bus—

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Dantsu Flame... Another one... has 
departed.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
A run so similar to mine... Yet a rogue is 
a rogue. No matter how anyone strugglesâ

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Perhaps the end is near.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: Trainer, and so I am... alone once more.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
There is no one left to share my dream of 
rising from the grassroots to overthrow 
the top. Not a single soul.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
How bleak the moon in the night sky is. 
—Well now, how will this turn out?
choice_data_list:
Yeah... This looks like it'll be an uphill 
battle...

Yeah... Looks like it's going to be an 
uphill battle...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
However, it is not over yet. Far from 
being over, autumn hasn't even begun.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As her Trainer, I'll do everything I can 
to support No Reason in her solitary 
battle.
